scenario.summary: Adds the products of the optionalAddonProductsSku table to the guest cart (search, add to cart, open cart for each). First method of the line-items chain: declares the three products for CartLineItems.
steps: For each row ProductSku1..N: search the SKU, add to cart and open the cart
stateChanges: Guest cart: N simple products added (kept for CartLineItems)
evidence: Rows used: Navigate.addMultipleSimpleProductIntoShoppingCart loops itemCount = 1..productsSkuDataMap.size() over keys ProductSku<itemCount> (GlobalVariables.SEARCH_PRODUCT_SKU) and reads column SimpleOptionalSku; ShoppingCart.verifySimpleProductShoppingCartLineItems compares cart row i with ProductSku<i> columns ProductName, ProductPrice (unit and total) and InitialQuantity. Table layout (adapter ExcelTables, the framework's own reader): table name row, header row, data rows until column A is blank. ProductSku1 is shoppingCart!B22 (scanned in ShippingCostTest), so the data rows start at 22; the next table, shippingCostDetails, has data rows at 28-29 (C28, B29), so its name row is 26 and a blank column-A row must precede it (otherwise its rows would join this map and ProductSku<n> lookups would fail). The table therefore has at most 3 rows (22-24); the exact count (2 or 3) needs the workbook, which is not read. Three distinct needs are declared: the migrated test loops over the declared needs, so it adds three products whatever the sheet holds today.

Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): this method runs first and declares every need and record value of the chain; the migrated class keeps the resolved record in a class field and the later methods read that field, so they have no needs of their own. Consumers: CartLineItems (name, unit price, total = price x quantity per row; sub-total and order amounts).
Outputs the chain reads: productN.sku (search), productN.name (ProductName), productN.salesPrice, else retailPrice (ProductPrice); InitialQuantity is 1 (config, quantityUsed 1).
Distinct records: product1..product3 are separate PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK needs; the resolver gives them different SKUs (identity sku), which the line-item comparison needs.

Source imported: optionalAddonProductsSku/ProductSku1/SimpleOptionalSku z-2420004 (shoppingCart!B22, recorded by the ShippingCostTest scan; this method reads the same cell through the loop) -> product1.sku, preferred (not required). ProductSku2/3 cells are not in any scan: no preferred.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
